title: Paycor pricing - Previously $99-$199/month base + per-employee, now custom quote only
clean_text: Historically, Paycor's tiers (per third-party buyer reports) were Basic at $99/month plus $6/employee/month, Essential at $159/month plus $9/employee/month, and Core (the most popular) at $199/month plus $12/employee/month. After pulling its public pricing page in 2025, Paycor now requires a custom quote for every deal. New customers commonly receive about 50% off for the first 6 months, with full pricing taking effect at month seven.

meta.pricing_model: tiered subscription, base plus per-employee (now custom quote only)
